scope: Focused initial-project regression using official runtime and exported script; result states forced only by the QA probe, not by learner starter code.

tests.test: Starter contains no groups, spawning, clock, points, health or gameplay result conditions
Only Enter and the drawing loop are supplied, with an empty Se jogando guard
Opening appears immediately; no movement or shooting is implemented
Enter starts the unfinished playing area without supplying the child rules
Enter during playing does not restart the unfinished project
QA-forced vitoria displays its prepared screen and Enter resets to opening
QA-forced derrota displays its prepared screen and Enter resets to opening
Supplied UI executes without missing variable, drawing or image errors
